messages.confirmReset: Are you sure you'd like to reset everything?
messages.confirmClearGraphs: Are you sure you'd like to clear the graphs?

screenSummary.playArea: The play area shows an object resting on a ramp that can be tilted from flat to steep. Force arrows, a free-body diagram, and energy and work charts visualize the physics.
screenSummary.controlArea: The controls choose the object and set the ramp angle, applied force, mass, and friction. You can toggle a frictionless ramp and sound, play, pause, or record and replay the motion. A Reset All button returns the simulation to its starting state.
screenSummary.interactionHint: Choose an object and adjust the ramp angle and applied force, then observe how the object moves.

a11y.currentDetails: The {{object}} is on a ramp tilted at {{angle}} degrees. Applied force is {{force}} newtons and the object is moving at {{speed}} meters per second.

block.accessibleHelpText: Use the left and right arrow keys to push the object along the ramp. Release the key to stop pushing.

controls.rampSurface: Ramp surface — drag to change the ramp angle
controls.freeBodyDiagram: Free-body diagram — drag left or right to push the object

keyboardHelp.changeAngleDescription: Tilt the ramp left or right.
keyboardHelp.changeAngleSlower: Change the angle in smaller steps
keyboardHelp.changeAngleSlowerDescription: Hold Shift to tilt the ramp in smaller steps.
keyboardHelp.pushObjectDescription: Hold Left or Right arrow keys, or A or D, to push the object along the surface. Release the key to stop pushing.
keyboardHelp.pushObjectGentlyDescription: Hold Shift as well to push the object with less force.
keyboardHelp.pushFromDiagramDescription: With the free-body diagram focused, hold Left or Right arrow keys, or A or D, to push the object. Release the key to stop pushing.
keyboardHelp.pushFromDiagramGentlyDescription: Hold Shift as well to apply less force from the diagram.
keyboardHelp.moveZeroPoint: Move the line up or down
keyboardHelp.moveZeroPointDescription: Hold Up or Down arrow keys, or W or S, to move the zero potential energy height.
keyboardHelp.moveZeroPointSlowerDescription: Hold Shift as well to move the line more slowly.
keyboardHelp.scrubTimeDescription: Move the graph time cursor earlier or later with Left or Right arrow keys, or A or D.
keyboardHelp.scrubTimeSlowerDescription: Hold Shift to move the time cursor in smaller steps.
